newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B share index closes down on Changan.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B share index closes down on Changan.

text.p: Shenzhen's B share index fell on Wednesday, dragged down by Chongqing Changan Automobile Co Ltd, which reported a substantial drop in profits for 1996, brokers said.
The index slid 1.56 points or 0.98 percent to end at 157.77 with turnover rising to HK$80.16 million from HK$64.57 million on Tuesday.

Changan, in its annual report issued on Wednesday, said its post-tax profits for 1996 fell 7.87 percent to 202.83 million yuan compared with 220.16 million in 1995, based on international accounting standards.
"Changan's 1996 results dampened the market mood," an analyst with J & A Securities said.
Changan was the day's biggest loser, falling HK$0.32 or 7.02 percent to HK$4.24, after touching an intra-session low of HK$4.10, on volume of 1.05 million shares.
"Changan dived on poor results but the share is unlikely to fall further as it now looks quite cheap," the analyst said.
Traders said caution amid the corporate report season would cap any B index gains.
"Changan has heightened the sense of unease (over the 1996 company results)," a trader at a western investment bank said.
Most of Shenzhen-listed B share companies have yet to release their 1996 results with the April 30 deadline approaching.
"Caution is likely to keep the index rangebound in the next few sessions," the western bank analyst said.

The A share index gained 9.29 points or 2.04 percent to end at 465.67 on a technical rebound after Tuesday's steep declines, brokers said. Turnover was 10.3 billion yuan against 11.7 billion the previous session.
